replication.target_description: SCORE primary replication report of Wetzel et al. (2016): prerequisite narcissism-class recovery H1 and contingent self-esteem comparison H*. No supplied description/study/test locator resolves the assigned target among these analyses.

n.sample_role: Candidate only: 1255 final eligible participants in pool; LCA draws contain 1000 participants; chi-square goodness-of-fit tests concern frequencies across runs. No row-specific critical-test analytic N established.
n.exclusions: Qualtrics screened attention-check failures before supplying 1260 quality completes; five cases removed for missing data.
n.location: p. 4, Sample Size; pp. 2 and 5–7, run-based analyses
n.quote: The final N of quality completes provided by Qualtrics was 1260. ... Missing data was extremely low and led to a removal of only five cases. ... Accordingly, the final sample size for the analysis was N = 1255.

es.location: p. 2, Replication Criteria; pp. 5–7, Replication Result
es.quote:
Testing the focal claim required a two-step analytic procedure, requiring a test of H1 before
attempting a test of H*. More specifically, the failure to find support for H1 precludes the test
of H*, which is entirely dependent on reliable class identification. ... This test
was statistically significant, χ2(1) = 7.56, p = .006, indicating a departure from the 80/20
distribution. ... χ2(1) = 9.42, p = .002 and χ2(1) = 76.56, p = .0000000000000002, respectively. ... confirmed as a statistically significant deviation, χ2(1) = 240.25, p = .0000000000000002.

notes: Identity: canonical text is a complete-looking 10-page primary SCORE results report, headed Replication of a research claim from Wetzel et al., 2016, European Journal of Personality. Team: Moin Syed; research scientist: Nick Fox. Project ID Wetzel_EurJournPersonality_2016_Ovkm - Syed - Direct Replication - zz26 and OSF replication project f5b6c match the supplied reference project; SOURCE_URL download/udbnf matches url_r. Citation on p. 10 matches original title, authors and DOI 10.1002/per.2062. Report version November 10, 2020 differs from reference date November 18, 2025; project identity established, bibliographic-date equivalence not established. This is a results report, not a preregistration or secondary article. No PDF supplied and no renders made. No description or test locator is supplied. Focal H* tests self-esteem between moderate ADM and ADM+RIV classes; report states failure of class identification H1 precludes H*, and reports class-recovery failure. No focal self-esteem coefficient/p is reported here. Multiple prerequisite tests cannot be mapped to the assigned row. Same-test printed candidates: p. 5 initial consistency chi-square 7.56, df 1, p = .006; p. 5 restricted 69-run consistency chi-square 9.42, df 1, p = .002; p. 5 all-100-run consistency chi-square 76.56, df 1, p = .0000000000000002; p. 7 exploratory class-definition consistency chi-square 240.25, df 1, p = .0000000000000002. Equality is retained as printed; report calls the last p the smallest R default. No metric conversion made; ser_method does not supply an identifiable test or metric definition. Candidate final participant pool N = 1255 is explicitly printed after five missing-data removals from 1260 quality completes. LCA used 1000 random draws of 1000 participants, with later class summaries reduced to 100 runs. Participant pool N is not automatically N for run-frequency tests or unperformed focal H*. No N summation used. All three assigned fields remain null, target_match null, confidence false. Candidates preserved for parent field-scope review. Unassigned original and reported_success are placeholders only.
